title: Charges Held Back for the Duty Manager on a Resort Lodging Folio
content:
Charges on a Resort Lodging folio are held back where the household has queried the folio. What is read is whether a folio dispute about the stay stands accepted at the desk, and what the folio itself carries.

Where a folio dispute about the stay stands accepted at the desk and the folio carries an occupancy charge for the stay, the occupancy charge standing on the folio is held back from what is collected now and stands over for the duty manager.

Where a folio dispute about the stay stands accepted at the desk and the folio carries no occupancy charge for the stay, the resort charge standing on the folio is held back instead.

Where no folio dispute about the stay stands accepted at the desk, nothing is held back.

| Folio dispute standing accepted | Occupancy charge on the folio | What is held back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the occupancy charge standing on the folio |
| yes | no | the resort charge standing on the folio |
| no | either | nothing |

### Three hypothetical folios

A folio carrying 240.00 USD of occupancy charge and 300.00 USD of resort charge, on a reservation where a folio dispute about the stay stands accepted at the desk, has the 240.00 USD occupancy charge held back and standing over for the duty manager.

The same folio with no occupancy charge at all, the dispute still standing accepted, has the 300.00 USD resort charge held back instead.

A folio on a reservation carrying no folio dispute standing accepted at the desk has nothing held back, whatever it carries.
